data.title: Route Overview
paragraphs: The route keeps the backwater experience compact: one land stay, one houseboat night, a smaller canoe outing, and village time away from the busiest channels.
data.caption: Kochi → Alleppey → Kuttanad → Vembanad

introParagraphs: 4 days, short transfers where possible, and a practical sequence that leaves room for weather, opening times, and actual human energy.

listItems: Transfer from Kochi.

Board a private houseboat.
Lunch on board.
Cruise through wider waterways and settle overnight.

listItems: Switch to a smaller canoe.

Return to a land stay by evening.

data.title: Backwater Basics
items: Smaller canoe outing through village canals.
Private road transfers in and out.
Meals on the houseboat as specified.

data.title: Before You Go
items: Pack light for the houseboat night.
Carry sun protection and insect repellent.
Choose a smaller canoe if you want the narrow canals.

data.quote: The best backwater moments usually happen after the engine goes quiet.
data.author: ESSENTIAL ROUTE NOTE

data.title: PRACTICAL NOTE
data.text: For quieter waterways, start early and avoid making the entire trip one long houseboat cruise.

data.title: Why This Route Works
paragraphs: This is the no-nonsense Kerala backwater essential: boat, village, food, water, sleep, repeat. Exactly enough.

items.question: Can the route be adjusted for our dates and pace?
paragraphs: Yes. Essential routes are starting templates, so nights, transfer points, and activity intensity can be adjusted before confirmation.

items.question: Who is this route best suited to?
listItems: Travellers wanting a straightforward 4-day plan.
Guests interested in backwaters & village life.
People who prefer dependable logistics over a heavily authored expedition.

items.question: Are all activities fixed?
paragraphs: No. Weather, local opening times, transport schedules, and personal energy can change the daily order without changing the core route.

items.question: What does the starting price cover?
listItems: Accommodation in the selected category.
Private transfers listed in the route.
Guiding or activity support where specified.
On-ground coordination for the confirmed itinerary.

items.question: How is the booking confirmed?
paragraphs: A confirmation deposit is collected after the final route, stay category, and travel dates are approved. Supplier-specific non-refundable amounts are identified before payment.

items.question: What happens if dates change?
paragraphs: We first try to move the same services to new dates. Any cancellation or amendment cost depends on the actual hotel, transport, guide, permit, and activity terms attached to the booking.
listItems: Date changes remain subject to availability.
Non-refundable supplier charges are passed through at cost.
Any revised balance is confirmed before rebooking.
